data.name: Errors_PromptCode
data.value: Read the code at the frames of the stack trace with source_read, and search it with source_search if you need to, giving the source "{0}" and the app "{1}". logs_errors finds related errors. The code may have changed since the error was logged. Say whether it is a bug, the likely cause, and the fix you would make, without changing anything.
